Years of Lower Saxony data available for a place

Source: R/data_lgln.R
rvt_data_lgln_years.Rd

Lists the flight years LGLN holds for a location, without fetching any data: one row per product and year, with the flight dates, the number of tiles involved, and whether that year covers the whole area.

Usage

rvt_data_lgln_years(x, product = c("dtm", "dsm", "rgb"))

Arguments

x

location: a WGS84 c(lon, lat) point or c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) extent, an sf point, geometry or bbox, or the path to an EPSG:25832 raster

product

one or more of "dtm", "dsm", "rgb" (default all)

Value

a data frame with columns product, year, first_date, last_date, tiles and covers

See also

rvt_data_lgln()

Examples

# \donttest{
rvt_data_lgln_years(c(9.9464, 51.6317))
#>   product year first_date  last_date tiles covers
#> 1     dtm 2016 2016-04-01 2016-04-01     1   TRUE
#> 2     dsm 2016 2016-04-01 2016-04-01     1   TRUE
#> 3     rgb 2013 2013-06-18 2013-06-18     1   TRUE
#> 4     rgb 2016 2016-03-17 2016-03-17     1   TRUE
#> 5     rgb 2019 2019-04-01 2019-04-01     1   TRUE
#> 6     rgb 2022 2022-03-13 2022-03-13     1   TRUE
#> 7     rgb 2025 2025-03-08 2025-03-08     1   TRUE
# }
